convert_torchvision_to_d2: convert a torchvision ResNet model pth file to Detectron2 compatible pkl format
run_model_conversion: run the torchvision to Detectron2 model conversion script with input pth and output pkl paths
remap_layer_keys: remap torchvision ResNet layer keys to Detectron2 naming conventions including stem and res layers
convert_bn_to_norm: convert batch normalization layer keys from bn format to conv norm format for Detectron2
export_pickle_model: export the converted model weights as a pickle file with matching heuristics metadata
